review: Same agent system second source/evidence review; no tests/network/workflow execution by reviewer
workflowDiff: one existing Node test command retains packaging and adds policy file; triggers, permissions, actions, sequence otherwise unchanged
limits: Presence detector is syntactic, not arbitrary shell/control-flow proof or immutable tamper-resistant security enforcement. PR author can edit both workflow and tests.
Policy step runs after npm/test stages; it cannot substitute for server-enforced fork permissions or secret settings.
Forty-hex known-action rule checks immutable shape/repository allowlist, not exact version bundle SCA or approved-SHA deny/allowlist.
Previous no-integration report remains historical; local tests do not prove GitHub server accepted/enforced new workflow.
